     6	class TTLCache:
     7	    """In-memory cache whose entries expire ``ttl`` seconds after they are set."""
     8	
     9	    def __init__(self, ttl, clock=time.monotonic):
    10	        if ttl <= 0:
    11	            raise ValueError("ttl must be positive")
    12	        self.ttl = ttl
    13	        self._clock = clock
    14	        self._data = {}
    15	
    16	    def set(self, key, value):
    17	        self._data[key] = (self._clock() + self.ttl, value)
    18	
    19	    def get(self, key, default=None):
    20	        entry = self._data.get(key)
    21	        if entry is None:
    22	            return default
    23	        expires, value = entry
    24	        if expires <= self._clock():
    25	            del self._data[key]
    26	            return default
    27	        return value
    28	
    29	    def delete(self, key):
    30	        self._data.pop(key, None)
    31	
    32	    def __contains__(self, key):
    33	        return self.get(key, _MISSING) is not _MISSING
    34	
    35	    def __len__(self):
    36	        self._purge()
    37	        return len(self._data)
    38

    40	        now = self._clock()
    41	        for key in [k for k, (expires, _) in self._data.items() if expires <= now]:
    42	            del self._data[key]
    43	
    44	    def clear(self):
    45	        self._data.clear()

     7	class TTLCache:
     8	    """In-memory cache whose entries expire ``ttl`` seconds after they are set."""
     9	
    10	    def __init__(self, ttl, clock=time.monotonic, max_entries=None):
    11	        if ttl <= 0:
    12	            raise ValueError("ttl must be positive")
    13	        if max_entries is not None and max_entries < 1:
    14	            raise ValueError("max_entries must be positive")
    15	        self.ttl = ttl
    16	        self._clock = clock
    17	        self.max_entries = max_entries
    18	        self._data = OrderedDict()
    19	
    20	    def set(self, key, value):
    21	        now = self._clock()
    22	        is_new = key not in self._data
    23	
    24	        # Only a new key can increase the number of entries.  Expired entries
    25	        # are removed before evicting an entry when the cache is full.
    26	        if (
    27	            self.max_entries is not None
    28	            and is_new
    29	            and len(self._data) >= self.max_entries
    30	        ):
    31	            self._purge(now)
    32	            while len(self._data) >= self.max_entries:
    33	                self._data.popitem(last=False)
    34	
    35	        self._data[key] = (now + self.ttl, value)
    36	        # A set is a use, including when it replaces an existing value.
    37	        self._data.move_to_end(key)
    38	
    39	    def get(self, key, default=None):
    40	        entry = self._data.get(key)
    41	        if entry is None:
    42	            return default
    43	        expires, value = entry
    44	        if expires <= self._clock():
    45	            del self._data[key]
    46	            return default
    47	        # A successful get is a use.
    48	        self._data.move_to_end(key)
    49	        return value
    50	
    51	    def delete(self, key):
    52	        self._data.pop(key, None)
    53	
    54	    def __contains__(self, key):
    55	        # Membership checks must not change the recency order.
    56	        entry = self._data.get(key)
    57	        if entry is None:
    58	            return False
    59	        expires, _ = entry
    60	        if expires <= self._clock():
    61	            del self._data[key]
    62	            return False
    63	        return True
    64	
    65	    def __len__(self):
    66	        self._purge()
    67	        return len(self._data)
    68	
    69	    def _purge(self, now=None):
    70	        if now is None:
    71	            now = self._clock()
    72	        for key in [k for k, (expires, _) in self._data.items() if expires <= now]:
    73	            del self._data[key]
    74	
    75	    def clear(self):
    76	        self._data.clear()
